projects.title: Kinegami
projects.subtitle: Compiling kinematic chains into tubular origami
projects.blurb: A design pipeline that takes a desired kinematic chain and produces a foldable tubular origami pattern, so a specified motion can be built directly as a physical mechanism.

projects.title: Programmable compliance
projects.subtitle: Origami mechanisms and tunable-stiffness actuation
projects.blurb: Joints and actuators whose stiffness is set by geometry rather than control, letting a robot store and release energy during dynamic motion and stay efficient as the ground changes.

projects.title: Leg-wheel transformable robots
projects.subtitle: Machines that change how they move
projects.blurb: Robots that shift between wheeled and legged locomotion while moving, so one machine can match its gait to the terrain it meets. Done during the PI’s master’s work at National Taiwan University; these robots set the questions the lab now asks.

projects.title: Monkey-bar terrain quadruped
projects.subtitle: Codesigning the gripper and the controller
projects.blurb: Gripper and controller designed together for a quadruped crossing monkey-bar terrain, where what the hand can hold decides what the controller can attempt.

projects.title: When is a body worth designing?
projects.subtitle: Task-to-intelligence mapping
projects.blurb: Asks when capability belongs in a robot's body rather than its controller, and what a task has to look like for that trade to pay off.

projects.title: Scaling across sizes
projects.subtitle: Scaling robots for dynamically similar tasks
projects.blurb: What has to change when the same behavior is demanded of a larger or smaller machine, and which parts of a design survive the change of scale.
